# FROZEN HISTORICAL ARTEFACT — DO NOT "FIX" THIS FILE.
#
# This is `scripts/qc-allowlists/required-contexts-release.txt` exactly as it
# stood BEFORE the #2494 residual declared the two decider contexts
# (`Classify changes`, `Coverage classify (docs-only short-circuit)`). It is the
# R-203 regression baseline for SECTION C of
# `scripts/test/test-ci-workflow-invariants.sh`, which asserts:
#
#   * this frozen mirror does NOT declare either decider (proving the SECTION C
#     declaration assertions are load-bearing rather than tautological); and
#   * with this mirror, a job-level `if:` planted on `ci.yml`'s `classify` job —
#     the decider that nine dependent jobs `needs:` — passes the soundness gate
#     SILENTLY, because a context the mirror never declares is a context no rule
#     is ever applied to. That is the defect the declaration closes, and rule
#     (b4) is what keeps it closed.
#
# Repairing this file (adding the two contexts) would make both legs vacuous.
# A committed fixture rather than a `git show` so the legs survive CI's shallow
# checkout instead of silently SKIPping — the #2496 lesson.
#
# WHAT "FROZEN" DOES AND DOES NOT MEAN HERE (#2473).
# The frozen property is the DECIDER ABSENCE, and it is asserted mechanically:
# SECTION C fails if either decider ever appears below. Everything else in this
# file is NOT frozen and CANNOT be, because the second leg runs the REAL gate
# with this mirror against the REAL (live) workflow directory and requires it to
# EXIT 0 — so any job rename anywhere in `.github/workflows/` that this file
# does not track makes rule (a) fail and the regression leg unrunnable, which
# would look like "the baseline no longer reproduces the blind spot" when in
# fact nothing about the blind spot changed.
#
# That is exactly what #2473 forced: `l3-boundary-gate`'s name is now QUOTED in
# `c8-precheck.yml`, so the workflow reports the FULL
# `L3-boundary perma-ban gate (§25.3 S5 / RQ-10 #1853)` and the truncated entry
# this file used to carry matches no job. The entry below was updated to the
# full name for that reason ALONE. It is not a "repair" in the sense this
# header warns against: the two deciders remain undeclared, both SECTION C
# legs remain load-bearing, and the historical truncation is preserved in the
# commentary below rather than in a line that would now break the harness.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# required-contexts-release.txt — the DECLARED required-status-check set for
# the protected branch `release/v1.0.0`, verified by
# `scripts/check-required-contexts.sh` (#2494 / #2496).
#
# ============================================================================
# *** HAND-AUTHORED FROM INTENT. NEVER GENERATE THIS FILE FROM LIVE API STATE.
# ============================================================================
#
# This file is the DECLARATION. Live branch protection is the ARTEFACT. The
# gate's job is to prove the artefact is sound; if the declaration is minted
# from the artefact, the gate proves nothing and passes forever.
#
# That is not hypothetical here. AT THE TIME THIS FIXTURE WAS FROZEN the entry
# below read
#
#     L3-boundary perma-ban gate (§25.3 S5 / RQ-10
#
# — TRUNCATED, because `.github/workflows/c8-precheck.yml` wrote the job name
# UNQUOTED:
#
#     name: L3-boundary perma-ban gate (§25.3 S5 / RQ-10 #1853)
#
# In YAML a `#` PRECEDED BY WHITESPACE opens a comment, so the parsed job name
# — and therefore the check-run name GitHub actually reported — stopped at
# `RQ-10`. The live required context carried the truncated form, so it matched
# and the gate was green on a name nobody wrote. Tracked as #2473, and CLOSED
# by it: the workflow name is quoted, both mirrors declare the full string, and
# the gate gained rule (e) — HARD-FAIL on any unquoted job `name:` containing
# whitespace-then-`#`. See "WHAT 'FROZEN' DOES AND DOES NOT MEAN HERE" at the
# top of this file for why the entry below tracks that rename.
#
# (Contrast the entries that contain `(#1174 PR10)`, `(#1989)`, `(#2146)`:
# those do NOT truncate, because there the `#` is preceded by `(`, not
# whitespace. The gate's parser implements the real YAML rule and reproduces
# both outcomes — the `--self-test` clean control asserts exactly that.)
#
# FORMAT
#   * A line whose first non-space character is `#` is a comment. Blank lines
#     are ignored.
#   * Every other line is ONE required context name, verbatim.
#   * An INLINE `#` is NOT a comment — several context names legitimately
#     contain one (see the `(#1174 PR10)` entries below).
#
# HOW TO CHANGE THIS FILE
#   Adding or removing a required context is a branch-protection edit
#   (Sensitive class, `docs/AI_DEVELOPER_GOVERNANCE.md`). Land the protection
#   change and this mirror together, and state the intent — not the API
#   response — in the commit message.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Carried by .github/workflows/ci.yml
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Non-matrix jobs with a job-level `if:` — these report `skipped` on a
# docs-only diff, which branch protection COUNTS AS SATISFIED. Each is
# recorded in the burn-down ratchet
# `required-contexts-joblevel-if-allow.txt` with its justification.
Lint (fmt + clippy)
actionlint (workflow-injection guard)
MSRV (Rust 1.98)
Postgres feature gate
SAL-only feature gate
vectorlite feature gate
Dockerfile build (no push)
#
# Matrix jobs following the proven pattern — NO job-level `if:`, docs-only
# guard on every step — so the EXPANDED names always report. Adding a
# job-level `if:` to either job re-opens the #2494 branch wedge and rule (b1)
# hard-fails for it.
Check (ubuntu-latest)
Check (macos-latest)
Check (windows-latest)
Cross-compile (aarch64-apple-ios)
Cross-compile (aarch64-linux-android)
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Carried by .github/workflows/c8-precheck.yml
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Unconditional integrity gates: no `needs:`, no job-level `if:`, no `paths:`
# filter. These are the nine contexts that genuinely run on every PR.
C8 caller-context allowlist check
Vendor-monoculture + SECS_PER_* lint-gate (#1174 PR10)
L3-boundary perma-ban gate (§25.3 S5 / RQ-10 #1853)
Hardcoded-literal duplication ratchet (pm-v3.1)
Docs vs SSOT drift gate
Cloud-init ASCII gate
Test-reachable stdin-read gate (#1989)
Migration-ladder-uniqueness gate (guardrail-D)
Test-env $HOME-lock gate (#2146)
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Carried by .github/workflows/coverage.yml
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Job-level `if:`; ratcheted like the ci.yml seven above.
Per-Module Coverage Thresholds
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# KNOWN GAPS — declared here so they are not mistaken for oversights.
# Closing any of them is a branch-protection edit, deliberately NOT done in
# this change.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#   * `Classify changes` (ci.yml) and `Coverage classify (docs-only
#     short-circuit)` (coverage.yml) are NOT required, yet between them they
#     decide the disposition of the eight ratcheted contexts above. Both
#     always run — no `needs:`, no job-level `if:`, `release/**` in
#     `branches:` — so requiring them is free and carries zero wedge risk.
#     THE natural companion fix to #2496; follow-up, protection-frozen here.
#   * Two c8-precheck integrity gates run on every PR but are not required:
#     `Installer checksum fail-closed gate (#2449)` and
#     `Non-Rust conformance-reader proof gate (#2452)`.
#   * `main` and `develop` require only `Check (ubuntu/macos/windows-latest)`.
#     That is the #2496 exposure: those three are the vacuous-success job, so
#     the branch that ships is the least protected in fact. Out of scope here.
